decision.reopen_trigger: Any dated FTMO Futures plan, phase, daily-loss, drawdown, eligibility, platform or launch-status correction; otherwise expire formal-launch language after September 20 and do not recreate the same daily-loss article.
decision.rationale: The prior package was explicitly beta-framed. A dated formal launch now changes the factual status, launch-specific search wording and short discovery window, while current official rules provide the same plan-specific USD 1,000 arithmetic anchor. The update is limited to the different reader question created by formal launch: distinguish a day-level loss boundary from planned price risk using a transparent buffer and reader-verified contract value. It does not rank firms, recommend a purchase, forecast futures, claim contract specifications or promise execution.

decision.reopen_trigger: Reopen only if a public, independently verifiable non-directional USD/JPY pip-value, position-size, margin or cost question appears with a distinct numeric input or workflow not already owned by the prior BOJ packages.
decision.rationale: The BOJ decision is well sourced and fresh, but source-backed attention is rate, yen and equity direction first. It does not produce a new reader calculation task; reusing a fixed-risk table would manufacture a search-to-calculator path that has not been verified.
